title: Content Superengine - analysis-data.json (core->format interface)
description: Machine-readable twin of analysis-data.md, emitted by competitor-cross-reference/analyze.py as the LAST write (md stays authoritative). Format engines (reel-scripter, render_visuals, future Carousel/Thread/...) consume ONLY this file. The boundary rule: core writes this schema, format reads it, no cross-skill code imports. VERSIONING: minor bumps (1.0 -> 1.1) are ADDITIVE-ONLY — new optional keys; consumers ignore unknown keys and must not require minor-version keys. Major bumps are breaking; consumers hard-stop on a major mismatch. Current: 1.4 (adds OPTIONAL field_lift / field_accounts / read on hook_taxonomy, theme_performance, gaps and the captions bucket -- the per-account lift the ranking comparators use, SKLLPLG-260 -- plus meta.dropped_pinned / dropped_junk / lift_min / transcript_coverage_min / degraded / baseline_days; 1.3 adds top-level outliers_full + period_breakouts and meta.generated_at; 1.2 added outlier.src, meta.transcript_coverage, top-level captions bucket; 1.1 added creator.hook_mix). THREE OUTLIER VIEWS since 1.3, do not confuse them: `outliers` = the all-time top-30 hall of fame (unchanged, capped); `outliers_full` = the same records uncapped AND client-excluded (the whole >=2.5x FIELD population); `period_breakouts` = what broke out INSIDE a declared window, also client-excluded, which neither of the other two can answer because the top-30 floor sits far above any single period's best reel. Since 1.2 the PRIMARY hook_taxonomy/theme_performance/outliers key on the SPOKEN transcript when one exists (caption fallback per reel, marked by outlier.src); the caption-keyed read lives in the separate top-level captions bucket — packaging surface only, never merged into the primary diagnosis.

creators.description: all creators incl. client, sorted by reach efficiency desc

lanes.description: omitted entirely when the project has no lanes

field_lift.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.4+): median over competitor accounts of med(views in this bucket) / that account's own median views (>=2 reels per account). 1.0 = neutral. THE ranking comparator; field_med_views is display only. null when no account qualifies.

field_accounts.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.4+): how many accounts contributed to field_lift.

read.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.4+): thin when field_accounts < 3 or field_n < 8; never a winner or loser read.

by_lane.description: lane -> {med_views, n}; present only when the project has lanes

gaps.description: themes the client under-serves vs the field — the primary scripting input. reason=absent (client_n==0) or underweight (client share << field).

oppo.description: optional 0-100 opportunity score (field value vs top theme)

field_lift.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.4+): the theme's per-account lift, carried so gaps rank on it.

outliers.description: reels >= 2.5x their creator's own median, ranked desc (top 30)

src.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.2+): which track keyed this outlier's hook/themes/hook_line

published_at.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.3+): UTC ISO-8601 publish instant. Emitted on period_breakouts.reels records (where the window makes it load-bearing); absent on outliers/outliers_full records.

transcript_coverage.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.2+): fraction of analyzed reels with a spoken transcript (0-1). 0 = caption-only run; health signal for degraded diagnosis.

dropped_pinned.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.4+, SKLLPLG-261): reels excluded BEFORE any median because post.flags.pinned was true.

dropped_junk.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.4+, SKLLPLG-261): reels excluded BEFORE any median as junk -- no views reported, a measured duration under 3s, or nothing said and nothing written. A MISSING duration never drops a row.

lift_min.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.4+): the floors behind read=thin ({accounts: 3, n: 8}).

transcript_coverage_min.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.4+, SKLLPLG-263): the coverage floor (default 0.6, analysis-config.json transcript_coverage_min).

degraded.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.4+): true when 0 < transcript_coverage < transcript_coverage_min; the md and console carry a loud line.

baseline_days.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.4+): --baseline-days window behind the lift denominators; null = all-time.

generated_at.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.3+): UTC ISO-8601 (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ) instant this file was emitted. The emit is guarded by a bare try/except that KEEPS the previous analysis-data.json on any error, so without this stamp a silently-stale file is indistinguishable from a fresh one. Consumers should compare it against the run they think they are reading.

outliers_full.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.3+): the UNCAPPED all-time >=2.5x FIELD population — every COMPETITOR reel that beat its own creator's median by >=2.5x, ranked desc. Identical record shape to `outliers`. CLIENT EXCLUDED (ruling 08.28.26): the client's own reels are not evidence about the field, so any consumer reading this for theme x hook or hook mining can honestly call it 'field outliers'. NOTE the asymmetry with `outliers`, which is client-INCLUSIVE by construction (it is the top 30 of the unfiltered population, sliced before this filter, so that its bytes never move). `outliers` is therefore NOT guaranteed to be the first 30 entries of this list — it happens to be on corpora where no client reel ranks that high, but do not rely on it. Use this list for any population read; use `outliers` only when you specifically want the all-time top-30 leaderboard. On 08.27.26 the cap hid 483 of 513 qualifying field reels.

period_breakouts.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.3+): what broke out INSIDE a declared window — the 'this week/period' answer. NEITHER `outliers` NOR a diff of two `outliers` lists can answer it: the top-30 is an all-time leaderboard whose floor (87.4x on 08.27.26) sits far above any single period's best reel (28.6x), so a period breakout can never enter it. Diffing two such lists reported 2 breakouts where 76 existed. Self-describing: window_from/window_to are literal UTC timestamps carried in the file, so a history/ snapshot answers for its own day and retroactive per-scan filtering is free — read the snapshot rather than recomputing a window. The window opens at the previous _delta/<date> pull, NOT at the newest history/ snapshot (those disagreed by 22 days on 08.27.26).

window_from.description: UTC ISO-8601 inclusive lower bound on published_at.

window_to.description: UTC ISO-8601 inclusive upper bound on published_at; equals meta.generated_at.

denominator.description: What the multiplier is measured against, named so a stale reading cannot be mistaken for a live one. 'all_time_median_views_gt0_at_generation' = each creator's all-time median views over ALL their reels (zeros included — the SAME median the `outliers` view uses), computed at generation time, NOT a within-window median. The '_gt0_' is a guarantee produced by the guard, not a filter on the sample: creators whose median is <=0 are skipped entirely (see creators_skipped), so every denominator actually used is >0. Do NOT re-implement this as a median over the views>0 subset — that skips nobody and hands a zero-view creator a synthetic denominator.

client_excluded.description: Handle omitted from this list — the client is never counted as a field breakout.

n.description: len(reels), carried so a truncated read is detectable.

creators_skipped_median_le_0.description: How many creators had an all-reels median of <=0 (more than half their reels report no views at all) and were therefore skipped rather than divided by. A 0 here on a real corpus is a red flag that the denominator was implemented as a views>0 subset median.

creators_skipped.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.3+): the handles counted by creators_skipped_median_le_0, sorted. Named rather than counted so a skip can be audited against the roster instead of taken on trust.

reels.description: Uncapped, no transcript requirement, ranked by mult desc. Same record shape as `outliers` plus published_at.

captions.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.2+): the caption-keyed read (packaging/SEO surface), present only when transcripts exist. Same shapes as the primary hook_taxonomy/theme_performance but keyed on caption text. NEVER merge into the primary spoken diagnosis.

hook_mix.description: OPTIONAL (schema 1.1+): {hook_type: reel_count} for this creator's analyzed reels. Consumers must tolerate absence (1.0 files).
